title: Third Coast Foundry (SF) — UChicago Polsky fireside on Incorruptible
summary: Third Coast Foundry in SF hosted the fireside for University of Chicago alumni, co-produced with the university's Polsky Center for Entrepreneurship. Karthee Madasamy, managing partner at MFV Partners, was in the room and wrote up the evening.
blockquote: The fun part for me — asking him about Milton Friedman and shareholder primacy in a room full of UChicago folks. The very idea he's challenging came out of Hyde Park. He didn't dodge, and the room didn't either.
attribution: Third Coast Foundry / UChicago Polsky Center
attribution_title: SF fireside chat for University of Chicago alumni
